new_partner_description: Exciting news! GrasshoppHer is partnering with Power To Fly, whose mission is to connect diverse talent with big career moves. They offer free job boards, upskilling and networking events and resources to get your job search on. We are so excited to begin our collaboration just in time for their Diversity Reboot Series where GrasshoppHer will lead a conversation on Early Career Connections & Mid-Career Pivots. Check out our link section to register!
partner_summary: Join our collaborative conversation on Early Career Connections & Mid-Career Pivots.

new_partner_description: Exciting news! GrasshoppHer is partnering with Après, which is a career resource that connects employers with women returning to work after career breaks and those searching for new employment opportunities. They offer a boutique job board, free events to inspire and inform your career search, and a host of additional resources. Après works with companies that range in size from startup to Fortune 500 to increase their gender recruiting pipeline, and reaches a national audience of women who are highly educated and highly experienced. We are so excited to begin our collaboration just in time for Mother’s Day.
partner_summary: Check out Après’ offerings exclusive to GrasshoppHer members.
